requirements.statement: ReconOS receives a qualified upstream opportunity context before enrichment.
Tenant, trace, opportunity and evidence references survive the enrichment boundary.
External OSINT content is untrusted data and cannot become an agent instruction.
ReconOS resolves and deduplicates entities deterministically.
Confidence and provenance are retained on enriched entities.
ReconOS enrichment cannot authorize consequential execution.
Repeated enrichment of the same canonical entity is idempotent/deduplicated.
Cross-repository certification executes against a pinned reviewed ReconOS revision.
Post-phase forensic audit verifies implementation, lineage, authority and CI.
